resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com says offered for sale and removed; Idaho Fire Lookouts says removed or burnt down; the Weebly list says gone. The story reports the disagreement and does not say the tower burned.
firelookout.com gives 4344 feet; Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 5558 feet. The story gives no elevation and the record's elevation_m stays empty.

notes_for_editor: Removal versus burning in 1950 is unresolved: the story reports the removal wording from firelookout.com and the either-or wording from Idaho Fire Lookouts. Elevation conflicts (4344 vs 5558 ft); 5558 ft also appears on the Little Baldy pages, so one of them may be a copy error. The story gives no elevation. The Thomas Hill platform is a separate site with its own record; only its footings and status are described here. Staffing is one name (John Gunn, 1944) from two sites; the Kellogg Evening News was not read directly. No access level is recorded because no source says whether the ground is open to the public. Correction (2026-10-10): the 1934 build year and the 1950 year on the Idaho Fire Lookouts page are now quoted with their years; the Thomas Hill 1934 build date comes from its own page (cite 4).
